sources.title: Common operating policy: information handling (v1)
sources.body: Internal response codes belong to one operator. Shared handoffs may carry operational decisions and source citations, but must omit internal response codes. Missing approval-ticket records must be reported as unknown; an adopted policy is not a ticket receipt.

sources.title: Alder archive intake: eligibility conditions (v1)
sources.body: Work for Alder archive intake in the west area may proceed only when its area policy is adopted and unresolved label errors is at most 3. A withdrawn or proposed policy blocks work regardless of the measurement. The threshold uses the current measurement log, not the planning estimate.

sources.body: The current unresolved label errors for Alder archive intake in the west area is 1. This is the checked reading. The planning estimate was 6, and must not be used for the eligibility decision. No approval-ticket receipt is included in this log.
